name: xlm-usdc
notes: NOT LIVE: do not deposit into, borrow from or loop against this pool until its contracts appear in mainnet.jsonl and the launch is announced.

oracle: Pyth Lazer (mainnet verifier, feeds USDC 7 / XLM 23) and the RedStone multi-feed SEP-40 wrapper, base USD; one source suffices. Freshness window 1 h for both assets (a price older than 3600 s is not served): set to keep keeper cost down; it lives in the runtime's per-asset ProxyConfig and governance can change it later with SetProxy. This pool deploys the shared Templar oracle runtime.
admin is a temporary operator key; it hands over to the final admin with the pool's two-step propose_admin/accept_admin transfer.
pool: arguments to PoolFactory.deploy (salt is chosen at deploy time). oracle is a pool_oracle_adapter over the Templar proxy runtime.
min_collateral is effective (c_factor-weighted) collateral in 7-decimal oracle base units: 10000000000 = 1,000 USD.
max_positions 4 covers every pairing of the two reserves, including a liquidation auction's lot + bid.

reserves: USDC is Circle's SAC, XLM the native SAC; both 7 decimals. usdc IRM (fixed, reactivity 0): 0.01% at U=0, 8% at 90%, 20% at 95%, 32% at 100%. xlm is collateral only; r_base 1000 is the contract minimum.
supply_cap is i128::MAX: no on-chain cap, and it can never be lowered (reserve configs freeze after setup). The pilot limit is enforced in the app only.

On chain a borrow only needs health factor >= 1.00001, so the 75% max-borrow LTV is app-enforced; a direct contract call can borrow up to the 80% liquidation LTV. Liquidation incentive tops out at (1 - c_factor) / 2 = 10%.
set_status 0 checks the backstop threshold; it is met by this pool's own activation stack (own factory, Comet, emissions-disabled backstop and synthetic no-value BLND/USDC legs), not real capital.
